title: Toggle
description: A labelled switch for interactive compositions (settings, options, sound on/off): a row with a label, an optional muted detail and an iOS-like switch. The whole row is the hit region; a tap, its hotkey or Tab + Enter emits change with the new boolean. Bind `on` to a variable and the thumb slides with a slight overshoot, stretches while held, the track fills with the accent and a tick or cross rides in the thumb. Focus ring, hover and press feedback; the row is at least a thumb tall on a phone. Takes a theme.

on.description: Its state: bind it to a boolean variable ({ "$var": "sound" })

hotkey.description: A key that toggles it (m, s…; empty: none)

plate.description: Sit on a surface row (off: bare, over the background)

side.description: Which end of the row the switch sits at

size.description: Switch height in % of the frame's short side (the row is at least 11)

textSize.description: Label size in % of the frame's short side

color.description: Track colour when on, a CSS colour (empty: the theme's accent)

outDur.description: Seconds of the exit at the item's end (0 while a scene holds for input)

author: claude-opus-5-5
